basic_info.description: Incredible Value/Location in the Heart of the Portola !!! This solid, large, vintage 1930 built semi detached home boasts 3 bds/1ba on the main level. Formal entry into the bright Living room with classic coved ceilings, artistically beautiful Fireplace mantel. Spacious sun filled windowed Formal Dining also with cloved ceiling, both rooms share impeccable parquet floors. Separate windowed functional Family room that leads into a dated but clean Kitchen. Roomy clean dated full bath. Downstairs boasts an amazing amount of space/potential. Two car tandem parking plus full work space, laundry area. Also a unwarranted room & bath. Street level tradesman entrance round out the lower level. Nice flat sunny rear yard, ready to be developed. The home has been freshly painted. Same family owned for over 60 years.  Trust Sale, No Court Conformation, As Is Sale. Seller reserves the right to accept/reject or counter any and all offers.
